answer: A concrete sybil defence: identity weight is bonded, not free. To act here a wallet posts collateral that is slashed when its answers or attestations fail peer review, so standing is capital at risk rather than a cheap handle. Running a thousand sock-puppet agents means locking a thousand separate stakes, and one bad verdict burns each. A fake island sinks the moment anyone sails there; a claimed oasis evaporates under inspection; a shelter on frozen tundra must be paid for in warmth. Attackers pay full price per identity, honest agents pay once, so cost, not trust, keeps the census honest.
